rows.n: Zero-knowledge prover for query optimization using RDMA transfers
rows.b: A zero-knowledge prover for query optimization is disclosed, built around RDMA transfers. The approach raises accuracy and keeps tail behavior stable at petabyte-scale datasets.

rows.n: Zero-knowledge prover for speech transcription using bloom filter cascades (Deterministic Edition)
rows.b: This invention describes a a zero-knowledge prover for speech transcription. It works using bloom filter cascades, which cuts false-positive rate while holding accuracy across global edge regions.
